description: Datadog monitors for the Virtual Coin Economy. All monitors target Prometheus-style metrics exposed by the NestJS backend via OpenMetrics and ingested by the Datadog Agent.

monitors.name: [Coin Economy] Coin purchase error rate spike
[Coin Economy] Revenue drop - no purchases detected
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
No successful coin purchases have been recorded in the last 30 minutes. This could indicate a complete outage of the coin purchase pipeline or the IAP webhook endpoint.

**Actions:**
1. Check the economy API health endpoint.
2. Verify Stripe / Apple / Google Play webhook endpoints are reachable.
3. Check for deployment or infrastructure incidents.
4. Verify API gateway rate limiting is not blocking purchase requests.
{{/is_alert}}

monitors.name: [Coin Economy] Fraud spike - excessive duplicate transactions
[Coin Economy] Abnormal coin balance - high-balance user spike
[Coin Economy] Daily check-in abuse
[Coin Economy] Gift economy imbalance
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
Gift spending exceeded 100000 coins in the last hour. Verify this is driven by legitimate user activity and not coin-laundering or economy manipulation.

**Current value:** {{value}} coins
**Threshold:** 100000 coins/hour

**Actions:**
1. Check the virtual_gifts table for top receiving users.
2. Check for circular gifting patterns (user A -> B -> A) that may indicate economy manipulation.
3. Verify gift transactions have legitimate senders and receivers.
{{/is_alert}}

monitors.name: [Coin Economy] Coin transaction latency spike
[Coin Economy] Sticker pack purchase anomaly
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
Sticker pack coin spending exceeded 50000 coins in the last 30 minutes. This is a high-velocity spend pattern that may indicate automated abuse or a pricing error.

**Current value:** {{value}} coins
**Threshold:** 50000 coins/30min

**Actions:**
1. Check for a single user making many rapid purchases.
2. Verify sticker pack pricing configuration hasn't been accidentally changed.
3. Check for any frontend issues causing double-submission of purchase requests.
{{/is_alert}}
